purpose: Adopt the upstream-contributed IDBFS linkage and native-exception build corrections into the full working SDK and the installed app package.
adoptedCorrections: Root CMakeLists compiles native C++ object libraries with -fexceptions whenever BUILD_WASM_MODULE is ON, before add_subdirectory(src).
wasm/CMakeLists.txt links -lidbfs.js while keeping the hand-written property-batch and gear-contact extension bindings.
vfs.ts normalizes . and .. segments, rejects NUL, and exposes WasmVfsManager.resolveRoots, which rejects equal or nested runtime/persistence roots.
JSBSimSdk.create resolves and validates both roots before loading the runtime module or allocating an executive.
writeDataFile, readDataFile, mkdir, enablePersistence, syncFromPersistence and syncToPersistence now check executive lifetime.
New regressions: malformed-propulsion native catch/recovery, four persistence-boundary cases, and a pinned Playwright browser persistence check.
Build and check runners enumerate test/*.test.mjs explicitly so the browser check is not run as a unit test.
deliberatelyNotAdopted: The review package's @jsbsim/wasm@0.1.0 identity, private/publish settings, upstream repository URL and LICENSES.md/NOTICE package-file inventory.
Removal of PropertyBatch, GearContacts, GEAR_CONTACT_FIELDS, child invalidation on model replacement, the property-batch bench and extensions.test.mjs.
Removal of source-archive extraction checks and the demo tracked-preview source-contract case.

sdkBuild.note: 45 previously accepted tests plus 5 new; typecheck and WASM/TypeScript compilation included.

negativeControl.note: With the engine -fexceptions block removed, a dirty diagnostic build gives 49/50 with the malformed-propulsion test failing on an escaped native exception (excPtr: 278536). Never promoted.

nativeIsolation.note: BUILD_WASM_MODULE:BOOL=OFF by default, no build/wasm directory, JSBSim 1.3.2.dev1 starts, 148 native compile commands contain no -fexceptions, and BUILD_WASM_MODULE=ON with a native compiler is rejected.

focusedAppTests.note: 143 previously accepted plus the added fork.4 in-tree version case.

productionBuild.note: Preflight, tsc, Vite build and emitted loader/WASM hash comparison; browserLoadedAssetsVerified remains false in dist/jsbsim-artifact.json.

limitations: These are software, artifact and identity results. They establish no aircraft calibration, AFM fit, terrain readiness or GPU performance claim.
Browser persistence was exercised with SDK-written fixtures only; the app itself still does not enable IDBFS persistence.
Upstream review of JSBSim #1505, #1506 and #1507 is separate from this local adoption and is not claimed to be complete.
Hosted CI was not re-run for this revision; the workflow now contains the browser step but no run is claimed.
Production builds retain the large renderer-chunk warning, some jsdom app tests retain React act warnings, and the component check still records a clipped lower LOD-select focus outline.
